label: Recorded Claude analysis · external session
editorial_label: Audited paraphrase of the reviewed Claude answer; not a verbatim quote.
transport: Claude-directed terminal calls to the local VESTA stdio MCP server.
summary: For PMMA, Kapton and silicone at 34% oxygen, 56.5 kPa and lunar gravity, VESTA returned no nearby-evidence questions, six with other or incomplete conditions, and three with no source in the collection. A retrieved NASA summary reports enhanced flammability near lunar gravity without material or atmosphere values; the matching FM2 record describes a planned mode, while the nearest PMMA and silicone rows have inferred or missing pressure.
review_question: Which retrieved results, if any, apply to these materials in this lunar cabin, and what evidence would a qualified reviewer need for the unresolved material–concern questions?
scope: Recorded interpretation of deterministic VESTA tool outputs, not a live model inside this website. This proposes a human review, not a physical risk ranking, material approval, test procedure or safety clearance. No sensor measurement or robot command occurred in this run.

evidence_notes.note: Summary statement about enhanced flammability near lunar gravity; no material, oxygen or pressure values.
Planned FM2 mode in the retrieved snapshot; no measured material outcome.
PMMA source row at 22.2% oxygen and microgravity; row pressure unreported, 101.3 kPa facility-inferred by VESTA.
Silicone source row at approximately 22.1% oxygen; microgravity and separate 1 g comparison outcomes; pressure unreported.

audit.method: Independent replay against the recorded release; JSON response equality, source-record and condition review.
audit.scope: Reproducible retrieval and computation, not independent scientific validation. The correction pass added no tool calls. The original initialize response was not stored verbatim.
